name: PlayStation 3 Blu-ray Remote
notes: 69-byte descriptor. Source: Linux kernel hid-sony.c ps3remote_rdesc, with its Usage Minimum (0x18) and Input (0x80) items written with a data byte of 0, the value HID 1.11 section 6.2.2.2 gives an item that carries none. Windows' HID parser knows neither item without its byte (HIDP_GETCOLDESC_ITEM_UNKNOWN) and fails the start.
